items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: I did have to dress in Aunt Jemimy clothes... there was a woman, a white woman named Maizie Ailing who was absolutely marvelous. She was the last word. She was a big woman, just what they wanted in Aunt Jemimy

ctx.x: Yes, in a Broadway show, you know, a -- in a white theater downtown back in the '20's.
Well, I think I'd have to -- well, I did have to dress in Aunt Jemimy clothes, but I would have to have dressed in Aunt Jemimy clothes, yes.
